status: Design only; no sampler edits, VM launches, workload input or host configuration changes.
existing_reuse: Raw stat/status/io and host CPU/meminfo capture
CPU clock tick and page size provenance

minimum_extension.selection: Opt-in two-report mode; reject duplicate PID/report/output; preserve existing single-report behavior.
minimum_extension.identity: Validate each executable/hash/start_ticks before observation; check identity before and after each multi-file sample. Missing process, changed identity or inaccessible required memory accounting fails the complete two-VM result explicitly; retain partial raw evidence.
minimum_extension.schedule: Single monotonic target schedule over60s; tick/stat/status/io1s, smaps_rollup at shared0,5,...,60s targets to reduce page-table scanning overhead. Retain actual per-file read start/end and each round span; skip missed targets rather than catch up in bursts.
minimum_extension.memory: Raw smaps_rollup plus parsed Rss/Pss/SwapPss and available Pss_Anon/Pss_File/Pss_Shmem, Private_Clean/Dirty. Convert reported kB to1024bytes; unavailable optional fields remain null. Never silently substitute RSS for missing PSS.
minimum_extension.host: Once per round raw /proc/stat CPU line, meminfo, loadavg, /proc/pressure/{cpu,memory,io}; record missing PSI as unavailable, not zero. Record sampler own process CPU at endpoints to expose observer overhead.
minimum_extension.scope: Two whole emulator processes only; runners/control clients are not included in process sums. No proc environment, credentials or unrelated process contents.

derived_metrics: Per-PID CPU tick deltas and actual elapsed spans; summed CPU seconds divided by shared wall span,100percent=one host logical core. Preserve endpoint skew rather than claim simultaneous reads.
Time series of contemporaneous RSS sum and PSS sum; peak of sampled sums, not sum of independent peaks. Per-PID values retained.
PSI total-counter deltas divided by interval microseconds; some/full separately. Host aggregate CPU and MemAvailable/swap accompany rather than attribute all host activity to VMs.
production_sequence: Root explicitly authorizes two runs after debug. Same frozen50 backing chain and exact binary/app/helper hashes; two unique writable leaves, copied auxiliary namespaces, private Unix control/display/serial endpoints, no writable disk sharing.
Retain base/ancestor hashes and confirm two actual iOS/app journeys separately, including original markers and reviewed counter0→1. A process existing alone is not a working VM.

Hold both at reviewed foreground counter1 for one aligned60s idle observation; identical display client/capture cadence and runner options. No builds or disk hashing during window; record unrelated host load instead of claiming perfect isolation.
If useful, separately measure one bounded identical counter workload per VM with each exact request/ack/actual tap record and endpoint timestamps. Do not mix idle and active windows.
Normal stop each VM, retain all raw observations, outcomes, unique leaves and paired-state provenance.
interpretation_limits: N=2 concurrency feasibility under this configuration only, not maximum density, sustained reliability or cost per runner.

RSS counts shared resident pages per mapping; PSS divides shared pages among their sharers. PSS sum is not total host memory cost and does not include every page-cache/kernel/control-process allocation.
Sequential /proc reads are not an atomic snapshot. Per-file timestamps/skew and sampler overhead remain visible.
Same guest image does not imply all guest RAM is shared. Do not divide available host RAM by one RSS/PSS measurement to assert capacity.
Lifecycle timing and screenshot receipt/presentation remain separate outcomes.

primary_references.supports: smaps_rollup aggregates mappings; RSS asynchronous approximation versus mapping accounting; PSS sharing semantics.
PSI some/full and total stall microseconds; host pressure is a contention observation, not per-VM attribution.
